source_definition.value: Experimental task condition contrasting blocks in which participants were instructed to increase insula activity by thinking happy thoughts with blocks in which they were instructed to relax and keep the thermometer low.

model_settings.value: Averaged Granger causality was estimated separately for each up-regulation and down-regulation block and averaged across sessions. Preprocessing included outlier removal, baseline correction, and percent-signal-change calculation within blocks. Significance was assessed using the distribution of sums of independent F statistics for non-causality and paired t tests comparing conditions, with FDR correction at p < 0.05.

spans.text: Basically, the Granger causality for a pair of brain regions was estimated at each up-regulation/down-regulation block, and then the avGC was established by averaging the estimated Granger causality during up-regulation/down-regulation blocks across different sessions.

description.value: Functional and localizer EPI data were slice-time corrected, realigned for movement, normalized to Montreal Neurological Institute standard space, and smoothed with an 8-mm Gaussian kernel.
